Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded in the final step that "Kirkov (The Boy Turns Man) has the older director" based on the birth years 1933 (Kirkov) and 1915 (Witney). This is a logical error: a person born in 1915 is older than a person born in 1933. The Planner failed to perform the basic comparison of the numbers it had successfully gathered (1915 vs 1933), leading to the wrong conclusion that the film with the director born later (Kirkov) has the "older" director.
